It is a very popular amulet in [[members]]-only worlds amongst players of all levels, as it provides good damage bonuses, has no requirements to wear, is much less expensive than the [[amulet of fury]], and offers useful [[teleport]]s. Like other dragonstone jewellery, it is one of the [[Wilderness#Member_teleportation_up_to_level_30_Wilderness|few items]] with a teleportation ability that will work up to level 30 Wilderness, while most other means of teleportation will not work above level 20 Wilderness. A trimmed version, the [[amulet of glory (t)]], may be obtained from hard [[Treasure Trails]], but is no different than a normal amulet of glory aside from appearance and the inability to use it for certain Treasure Trail steps. Certain Treasure Trail clue steps in the Hard, Elite and Master tiers require having an amulet of glory equipped, which can be difficult for [[ironmen]], given the very high Crafting level of 80 required. However, this can be somewhat alleviated by using a [[mushroom pie]] to temporarily boost Crafting by 4 levels, meaning an actual Crafting level of 76 is required for these clue steps. ==Combat making== {{Mmgsection|Enchanting dragonstone jewellery|Creating eternal glories}} ==Teleportation options== Players can access the teleports by either right-clicking the amulet in their inventory and selecting "rub", or right-clicking it while equipped and selecting one of their destinations. {{TeleportLocationTableHead}} {{TeleportLocationLine|name=[[Edgeville]]|x=3087|y=3496|mtype=pin}} {{TeleportLocationLine|name=[[Karamja]]|x=2918|y=3176|mtype=pin}} {{TeleportLocationLine|name=[[Draynor Village]]|x=3105|y=3251|mtype=pin}} {{TeleportLocationLine|name=[[Al Kharid]]|x=3293|y=3163|mtype=pin}} {{TableBottom}} The teleport locations allow access to other nearby transportation methods: * From Edgeville, players may use the [[canoe]] system to travel up and down [[River Lum]], the [[fairy ring]] system (one is located east of Edgeville), and the [[Grand Exchange]] via an underwall tunnel (level 21 [[Agility]] required), which itself grants access to the [[Spirit tree]] network and the [[dwarven carts]]. * The Karamja teleport puts the player close to the [[charter ship]]s system. * Draynor Village is close to [[Port Sarim]] for transportation for boats. * The Al Kharid teleport is near the [[Shantay Pass]], allowing access to the [[Kharidian Desert]] and the [[magic carpet]] system, and the [[gnome glider]] to the north. Amulets of glory are very useful for training [[Runecraft]] through the [[Abyss]], as they provide a fast way to return to [[Edgeville]]. They can also be used for crafting [[law rune]]s by taking the boat to [[Entrana]], then teleporting to [[Draynor Village]] to bank the runes. ===Price per teleport=== The price per teleport of the 4 charge and 6 charge amulet change depending on Grand Exchange prices. Per Charge |- |{{plinkt|Amulet of glory|txt=6|pic=Amulet of glory(4)}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Amulet of glory(6)}}}} |{{plinkt|Amulet of glory|txt=0}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Amulet of glory}}}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Amulet of glory}} - {{GEP|Amulet of glory(6)}}}} |{{Coins|({{GEP|Amulet of glory}} - {{GEP|Amulet of glory(6)}}) / 6 round 2}} |- |{{plinkt|Amulet of glory|txt=4|pic=Amulet of glory(4)}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Amulet of glory(4)}}}} |{{plinkt|Amulet of glory|txt=0}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Amulet of glory}}}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Amulet of glory}} - {{GEP|Amulet of glory(4)}}}} |{{Coins|({{GEP|Amulet of glory}} - {{GEP|Amulet of glory(4)}}) / 4 round 2}} |} ==Recharging== After at least one charge has been used, an amulet of glory can be recharged by using it on either the [[Fountain of Uhld]] or the [[Fountain of Heroes]], requiring completion of [[Dragon Slayer II]] or [[Heroes' Quest]], respectively. Doing so will charge all the amulets in the player's inventory to 4 charges. Players can also use a [[charge dragonstone jewellery scroll]] (requires completion of Heroes' Quest) or cast the [[Recharge Dragonstone]] [[Lunar spell]] (with 89 [[Magic]] and completion of the hard [[Fremennik diary]]) to restore all amulets in their inventory to 4 charges. Alternatively, players can charge the amulet at the [[Fountain of Rune]] (this also requires completion of Heroes' Quest to use), which is located east of the [[Demonic Ruins]] in the [[Wilderness]]. Charging an amulet of glory at the Fountain of Rune grants 6 charges instead of the usual 4. Attempting to reclaim a stack of amulets of glory (6) worth over {{coins|100,000}} from death's office will incur a fee of 10% of GE value per glory. When a player charges amulets of glory at the Fountain of Rune, there is a 1 in 25,000 chance that an amulet of glory will turn into an [[amulet of eternal glory]], which provides unlimited teleport charges. When this occurs, a message in the chatbox will appear, stating {{Mes|The power of the fountain is transferred into an amulet of eternal glory. It will now have unlimited charges.}} ==Other uses== Wearing an amulet of glory with '''any amount of charges''' (other than zero) while [[Mining]] increases the chance of rolling an uncut [[Gems|gem]] table ''instead'' of receiving an ore from 1/256 by 1/86 to 1/64.2; this neither depletes the ore nor grants Mining experience.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/830809149210521601|date=7 Feb 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98499|archivedate=18 Jun 2019|quote=[the actual increase when wearing the amulet of glory while mining is] 1/86 rather than 1/256 for a gem.}} Note that the [[Drop_table#Mining_gem_drop_table|mining gem drop table]] has a 54.7% chance to give nothing, so the actual chance to get a gem while mining is increased from 1/565.1 to 1/141.7. It will also significantly increase the speed of mining [[gem rocks]]. However, it has no effect in the salt mines on [[Weiss]]. After completion of [[Sins of the Father]], it affects [[daeyalt essence]] mining by increasing the rate of gems mined, although this lowers the rate of obtaining shards. At level 47 [[Construction]] (boosts such as the [[crystal saw]] work), the amulet can be [[amulet of glory (mounted)|mounted]] in a [[player-owned house]], within the [[Quest Hall]]. This requires an uncharged amulet of glory and three [[teak plank]]s. While mounted, this amulet provides unlimited teleport charges. Unlike other mounted quest trophies, mounting the amulet of glory does not require the completion of [[Heroes' Quest]]. Removing the mounted amulet returns it to the player. ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Amulet of glory|Amulet of glory(4)}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Amulet of glory}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Amulet of glory, Amulet of glory(4), Amulet of glory(6)}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 31 August 2017 |update = Fossil Island Kudos Display, the Champion's Cape, and much more. |change = Partially charged versions of the item could now be turned into bank placeholders. }} {{Subject changes |date = 9 February 2017 |update = Colourful Golems & Graphical Improvements |change = The uncharged version was made darker to distinguish it from charged versions. }} {{Subject changes |date = 26 February 2015 |update = The Grand Exchange |change = Partially charged versions of the item were made untradeable on the [[Trading Post]]/[[Grand Exchange]]. }} {{Subject changes |change = You can now recharge [[dragonstone jewellery]] at the [[Fountain of Rune]]. |date = 27 March 2014 |update = Wilderness Feedback Update }} {{Subject changes |date = 29 March 2004 |update = RS2 Launched! |change = The multiple charge versions became permanently available with the launch of ''RuneScape 2''. }} {{Subject changes |date = 1 December 2003 |update = RuneScape 2 Beta is Here! |change = The multiple charge versions were added to the ''RuneScape 2'' Beta. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== Uncharged= {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Amulet of glory detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Amulet of glory (v1) detail.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Amulet of glory detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Amulet of glory (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Amulet of glory v1.png|center]] |[[File:Amulet of glory.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2

It is a very popular amulet in [[members]]-only worlds amongst players of all levels, as it provides good damage bonuses, has no requirements to wear, is much less expensive than the [[amulet of fury]], and offers useful [[teleport]]s. Like other dragonstone jewellery, it is one of the [[Wilderness#Member_teleportation_up_to_level_30_Wilderness|few items]] with a teleportation ability that will work up to level 30 Wilderness, while most other means of teleportation will not work above level 20 Wilderness. [[Spirit tree]] network and the [[dwarven carts]]. * The Karamja teleport puts the player close to the [[charter ship]]s system. * Draynor Village is close to [[Port Sarim]] for transportation for boats. * The Al Kharid teleport is near the [[Shantay Pass]], allowing access to the [[Kharidian Desert]] and the [[magic carpet]] system, and the [[gnome glider]] to the north. Amulets of glory are very useful for training [[Runecraft]] through the [[Abyss]], as they provide a fast way to return to [[Edgeville]]. They can also be used for crafting [[law rune]]s by taking the boat to [[Entrana]], then teleporting to [[Draynor Village]] to bank the runes. ===Price per teleport=== The price per teleport of the 4 charge and 6 charge amulet change depending on Grand Exchange prices. It will now have unlimited charges.}} ==Other uses== Wearing an amulet of glory with '''any amount of charges''' (other than zero) while [[Mining]] increases the chance of rolling an uncut [[Gems|gem]] table ''instead'' of receiving an ore from 1/256 by 1/86 to 1/64.2; this neither depletes the ore nor grants Mining experience.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/830809149210521601|date=7 Feb 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98499|archivedate=18 Jun 2019|quote=[the actual increase when wearing the amulet of glory while mining is] 1/86 rather than 1/256 for a gem.}} Note that the [[Drop_table#Mining_gem_drop_table|mining gem drop table]] has a 54.7% chance to give nothing, so the actual chance to get a gem while mining is increased from 1/565.1 to 1/141.7.
